runtime.input: Write one UTF-8 JSON request to a temporary file, then use internal <operation> <target> --input-file <request-path>. No shell pipe or command discovery.

outreach-draft.ask: Could we discuss your last example

template.output: Actual full prebuild contract. For formal evaluation copy this returned object; do not reconstruct enums or required nested fields from memory.

input.changes: Only changed evidence sections; whole sections replace current ones. Read evaluation-update-schema once for exact field schemas.

evaluation-update.output: Validated saved evaluation with version/hash. Runtime retains receipts and working notes and constructs stage/brief. reported_metric requires metric {name,value,unit,period,reportedBy}; never classify a number as reported_metric with metric:null. Save is not review or Act approval.

evaluation-plan.output: completion {version,hash,requirements:[{code,path,owner,operation,message}]} from the readiness validators, plus research/quality contract. Resolve all material gaps; no founder bookkeeping questions.

input.evidence: Optional append {sources,claims,research}, retained stable IDs; identical duplicates are no-ops, conflicting IDs rejected.
input.assessments: Array of {scope:business|technical,topic:exact schema topic,status:findings|unknown_after_search|not_relevant,claimIds:[],runIds:[],reason,question}. Actual relevant attempts only. Maps coverage and question links once.
input.changes: Optional changed whole sections using evaluation-update-schema. Preserve current evidence. No managed ide/workingContext.

finish-evaluation.output: Atomic complete evaluation/readiness with version/hash, or all unmet requirements and saved:false. Read dossier. Never founder or Act approval.

prebuild.input: Returned template/current context with expectedVersion from the target; add actual retained sources, claims and research. stage is intention/define/evaluate, never prototype. project.entry is unknown/fresh/existing, never idea. Every observed/inferred finding needs supporting retained claimIds; unsupported facts stay basis:unknown, text:null, claimIds:[]. feedbackClaimIds is only founder_reported claims, never public observations or simulated interviews. Notes do not become evidence or consent.

working-context.limits: Create the chosen unused child target directory before start:true. Each fact value <=320 characters; source is required (null or string <=240). Split price, risk and next_move into separate short facts. Inferred facts cannot have high confidence. Later updates omit start and use returned version. On explicit continuation in a new conversation, add --resume to this write operation as well as context reads; never use it for a new idea.

revise-foundation.output: Invalidates affected review; no confirmation. Use for a founder correction instead of rebuilding the dossier.

present-thesis.output: context.presentation: keep id, basis and exact text in chat; display text unchanged

confirm-thesis.output: Check context.confirmations before acknowledging saved review. Never Act approval

interpretation.explanation: Explain clear agreement with this exact displayed subject, including unchanged scope and exclusions. Supply for natural replies beyond the conservative yes recognizer.

confirm.output: Record only the current displayed subject. Never interpret refusal, ambiguity, correction or changed scope as agreement. Explicit exclusions of external actions and an approved MVP stopping point do not authorize those actions. A Core validation error is not host automatic approval review. Read back receipt before acknowledgment.

build-transition.output: Truthful capabilities of this actual current host. No new approval.

continue-build.output: Verified same-project build continuation and handoffHash. host is nested here, unlike build-transition. Paths are relative to the selected Core projectReference, never parent escapes. Fresh project with no code uses paths:[]; existing app requires actual permitted files inside this root. Reuse prior unchanged authorization; do not invent a new chat or ask the founder to type the continuation phrase.

contractNotes.project-binding: Runtime checkout, founder app and conversation notes are distinct roots. project-bootstrap and working-context reject the runtime checkout and its children. Use supplied app context; missing app access does not block public work.
contractNotes.bounded-learning: quality.learning optionally accepts decision go/one_gap/pivot_stop and experiment {promise, capabilities [1–3], cuts, limitations, success, failure, testDate YYYY-MM-DD}. go + build_decision required for an experiment. Retain actual uncertainty. Exact displayed experiment binds Act; negative decisions cannot build.
contractNotes.present-thesis: For initial review, use compact notes: founder.objective and project.customer/problem with source, known/inferred status, medium/high confidence. Only missing provisional drafts are populated; notes remain assumptions, never independent evidence or consent. Existing definitions and skipped/undecided intention are preserved. Full Evaluation remains separate.
contractNotes.research-decision: kind: money/competition/technical/first_users/other; evidence: none/current/stale/estimate; optional cityRegion <=120 chars when locality matters.
contractNotes.founder-move: productStage: idea/prototype/built/live/unknown; customerEvidence: none/weak/current; evidenceHorizon: immediate/short/long; founderEffort: low/high; fasterEvidence boolean. Optional fields preserve older inputs.
contractNotes.first-user-plan: Optional region <=120 chars, required for local_smb. At most 8 habitats: {name <=160, sourceUrl public HTTPS, observed <=500, participation allowed/check_rules/restricted, role research/acquisition/both, fit high/medium/low}. Never invent observations.
contractNotes.outreach-draft: channel: email/dm/call/voicemail/interview/beta; audience <=160, observedContext <=300, ask <=220. sourceUrl is inspected public route, routeReviewed boolean. Always draft-only.

definition: SHA256 of sorted repository-relative dist/src/path:lowercase-SHA256(content), newline joined with no trailing newline. Independent encoding comparison matched this definition.
